kurs.name: Power Automate live course of the Power Platform Academy
kurs.status_satz: The next dates are not set yet, you can join the waiting list on the course page.

guertel.name: White belt
guertel.kann: You test flows, read the inputs and outputs of every action and format dates directly.

naechste.titel: Format the date directly in utcNow()
Test a flow before it goes live

guertel.name: Yellow belt
guertel.kann: You write your first expressions, filter and clean up arrays and test loops with just a few items.

naechste.titel: Fixed values in Compose instead of variables

guertel.name: Orange belt
guertel.kann: You catch errors with scopes, control concurrent runs and return data to Power Apps.

naechste.titel: Catch errors with Try, Catch and Finally
Set a timeout for long-running actions

guertel.name: Green belt
guertel.kann: You process messy data safely, speed up loops and call SharePoint and Microsoft Graph directly.

naechste.titel: Run Apply to each in parallel
A JSON schema that tolerates null

guertel.name: Blue belt
guertel.kann: You read the real error message from a scope and pass it on to people or agents.

naechste.titel: Read the real error message with result()

guertel.name: Brown belt
guertel.kann: You keep processes alive for weeks, even beyond the run duration limit of a flow.

guertel.name: Black belt
guertel.kann: In progress: one tip is in the question pool; no technique page has been released yet.

fragen.frage: When do you switch Filter array to Advanced Mode?
antworten: When several conditions belong in one filter
When you want to sort the items by a field
When the filter should run directly in SharePoint
fragen.erkl: Correct. In Advanced Mode you write the condition as an expression and combine several checks with and() or or().

fragen.frage: What is a JSON viewer extension for when you work with flows?
antworten: Show raw JSON in a readable, structured way
Repair broken flows automatically
Convert JSON into premium connectors
fragen.erkl: The extension indents raw JSON from a run and lets you expand and collapse it. That way you find the property you need in your expression.

fragen.frage: Where does an email address go that never changes during the flow?
antworten: In a variable, so the flow runs faster
In a Compose action or in Parse JSON
In a separate Condition at the start of the flow
fragen.erkl: Correct. Fixed values need no variable. Compose or Parse JSON make it clear that the value does not change.
fragen.titel: Fixed values in Compose instead of variables

fragen.frage: What does the expression utcNow('dd.MM.yyyy') return?
antworten: The current time in Swiss local time
An error, because formatDateTime() is missing
Today's date in the format day.month.year
fragen.erkl: Correct. utcNow() accepts the format as a parameter, so you do not need formatDateTime() for it.
fragen.titel: Format the date directly in utcNow()

fragen.frage: What does union() return when you pass the same array twice?
antworten: The array without duplicate entries
The array twice, one after the other
Only the entries that appear twice
fragen.erkl: Correct. union() returns each value only once, so union(x, x) works like DISTINCT.

fragen.frage: What does an automated backup of flows and apps build on?
antworten: Scheduled exports of the solution as a ZIP file
A copy of every flow in the owner's mailbox
The action outputs stored in the run history
fragen.erkl: Flows and apps sit in a solution, and a scheduled flow exports it regularly as a ZIP to SharePoint, OneDrive or Azure Blob. You import that file again when you need to restore.

fragen.frage: What does a test run show you that you don't otherwise see in the designer?
antworten: The number of licenses your flow consumes
The inputs and outputs of every single action
A list of all people who use the flow
fragen.erkl: Correct. In a test run you open each action and see which values it received and returned.
fragen.titel: Test a flow before it goes live

fragen.frage: What do you replace before pasting a Filter array expression as a trigger condition?
antworten: The leading @ character with a # character
Nothing, the expression works unchanged
item() with triggerOutputs() or triggerBody()
fragen.erkl: Filter array evaluates each element with item(), which does not exist in a trigger. In the trigger condition you therefore reference triggerOutputs() or triggerBody().

fragen.frage: What do you check after pasting copied actions?
antworten: The licenses of everyone who uses the flow
Whether the Scope was deleted in the old flow
Connections and dynamic content from the old flow
fragen.erkl: Correct. Connections are not copied, and references to actions of the old flow do not resolve in the new one.

fragen.frage: Where do you put Terminate so Finally can clean up first?
antworten: Inside Catch, just before the error notification
After Finally, only if Catch ran
Before Try, with status Failed
fragen.erkl: Correct. Finally cleans up first. A Condition then allows Terminate with status Failed only if Catch ran.
fragen.titel: Catch errors with Try, Catch and Finally

fragen.frage: What do you get from Format data by example or its successor, the Copilot expression assistant?
antworten: A ready-made template for the whole flow
A new data source with formatted values
The matching expression for your example
fragen.erkl: You give an example or describe the format you want, and Power Automate generates the expression, for example formatDateTime() for a date. The classic feature has been replaced by the Copilot expression assistant.

fragen.frage: How do you save a password-protected file from the web?
antworten: Authenticated HTTP request, then "Create file"
Only "Upload file from URL" with the file URL
"Get file content" directly with the web address
fragen.erkl: An HTTP request with authentication fetches the protected content, and "Create file" saves it. "Upload file from URL" only suits public files.

fragen.frage: What does a flow have to be so you can change its owner directly?
antworten: Turned off
Solution-aware
A child flow
fragen.erkl: If the flow is in a solution, you change the owner directly under Details. Connections and run history stay intact.

fragen.frage: In a manually triggered flow, where do you find the email address of the person who started it?
antworten: In outputs('Compose')?['body']
In triggerOutputs()?['headers']
In workflow()?['run']?['name']
fragen.erkl: The manual trigger returns x-ms-user-email among its headers. You read the address with triggerOutputs()?['headers']?['x-ms-user-email'].

fragen.frage: How do you merge two arrays and keep the duplicates?
antworten: join(), concat() and then split()
union() with both arrays as parameters
intersection() with both arrays
fragen.erkl: union() removes duplicate items. With join() both arrays become text, concat() appends them and split() turns the result back into an array.

fragen.frage: How do you make the Overwrite toggle visible in Create file?
antworten: Turn off Allow chunking in the settings
Turn on Concurrency control in the settings
Delete the existing file first with Delete file
fragen.erkl: As long as chunking is on, Create file hides the Overwrite toggle. Without chunking it appears, but very large files can then fail.

fragen.frage: Why do you add a description property to the Parse JSON schema?
antworten: It validates incoming data more strictly against the schema
It shows in Dynamic content and tells same-named fields apart
It automatically makes the field required in the schema
fragen.erkl: The description appears in Dynamic content below the field. This lets you tell apart two fields with the same name.

fragen.frage: What does coalesce() return?
antworten: The last value in the parameter list
The first value that is not null
All values joined into one text
fragen.erkl: coalesce() checks the values in order and returns the first one that is not null. In Power Automate an empty string does not count as null.

fragen.frage: What is an advantage of the PowerApps V2 trigger?
antworten: It works without any connection to data sources
It starts the flow automatically on a schedule
Typed inputs such as text, number or yes/no
fragen.erkl: You set the type for every input, for example text, number, yes/no, email or date. The title and description of each input appear in Power Apps when you call Run().

fragen.frage: What happens to new trigger events with a parallelism of 1?
antworten: They are discarded immediately and never run
They wait until the current run has finished
They still run in parallel, just more slowly
fragen.erkl: Correct. Further runs wait in a queue and start one after another.

fragen.frage: What does Static Result do to an action?
antworten: It runs, but its output is not saved
It only runs when you start the flow manually
It returns a fixed output without running
fragen.erkl: Correct. The action counts as successful and passes on the predefined result without actually running.
fragen.titel: Test with Static Result without changing data

fragen.frage: What do you gain by turning a Name/Value table into a JSON object?
antworten: Direct access to every entry by its name
An automatic translation of all values in the table
A faster query of the SharePoint list in the flow
fragen.erkl: Instead of looping through the table and comparing every name, you read the value directly by its name after Parse JSON.

fragen.frage: Where do you use FetchXML in a flow?
antworten: In the Fetch Xml Query parameter of the List rows action
In the trigger condition of the Dataverse trigger
In a separate FetchXML action of the Dataverse connector
fragen.erkl: List rows accepts FetchXML directly in the Fetch Xml Query parameter, no separate action is needed. This enables joins and grouping that the OData filter cannot do.

fragen.frage: Which step finally removes all collected apps and flows at once?
antworten: Exporting as a managed solution
Deleting the unmanaged solution
Deleting the imported managed solution
fragen.erkl: After the re-import the apps and flows belong to the managed solution. Deleting it removes all its components in one step, without further confirmation.

fragen.frage: According to the tip, what do you use Scopes for?
antworten: To trigger other flows from the running flow
To group actions and isolate errors
To store variables across several runs
fragen.erkl: A Scope bundles actions into one block. If something fails inside it, you react to the whole block, and you can copy the block into other flows.

fragen.frage: How many operations does one SharePoint $batch call bundle at most?
fragen.erkl: The SharePoint REST API accepts up to 1000 create, update or delete operations in one $batch call. Instead of hundreds of single actions you send one HTTP request.

fragen.frage: Which way brings a flow to colleagues together with its dependencies?
antworten: Send them a screenshot
Package it in a solution
Share the run history
fragen.erkl: A solution bundles apps, flows, connection references and tables. On export and import the dependencies move along.

fragen.frage: Which status does the Do Until loop report when Count or Timeout ends it?
antworten: TimedOut
Succeeded
Cancelled
fragen.erkl: Even when Count or Timeout stops the loop, it reports Succeeded. That is why you check the variable after the loop to see whether the wait worked.

fragen.frage: Why do you need an overview of which flow calls which?
antworten: To save licenses for child flows
For the right order during deployment
To delete unused flows automatically
fragen.erkl: Child flows must exist and be turned on in the target environment before you activate the parent flow. The overview shows you this order and which flows a change affects.

fragen.frage: When do you use the HTTP actions in Power Automate?
antworten: Only for testing flows before going live
For every query on a SharePoint list
When no ready-made connector covers the API
fragen.erkl: HTTP actions call any REST API, including Microsoft Graph. You need them where the ready-made connectors fall short.

fragen.frage: What does item()?['id'] return when the property id is missing?
antworten: The value null, and the flow keeps running
An error that stops the action immediately
The value of the previous item in the array
fragen.erkl: Correct. The question mark turns a missing property into null instead of failing the action.

fragen.frage: Which problem do environment variables solve?
antworten: Missing licenses for premium connectors
Hardcoded values that differ per environment
Slow loops over large amounts of data
fragen.erkl: Environment variables replace hardcoded values. The same solution then moves from Dev through Test to Prod without changes.

fragen.frage: What does PowerDocu need as input?
antworten: An export of your flow, app or solution
Read access to the environment's run history
A premium license for each documented flow
fragen.erkl: PowerDocu is a free tool for Windows. You export the flow, app or solution and get documentation in Word, Markdown or HTML.

fragen.frage: According to the tip, how do you turn an array into an object?
antworten: An Apply to each loop with Append to array
The Create HTML table action with custom columns
A Select action and nested replace() expressions
fragen.erkl: Select builds the key-value pairs, and the nested replace() expressions remove brackets and separators until a single object remains. You don't need a loop for this.

fragen.frage: When must you not raise the concurrency of a loop?
antworten: When it has to process more than a hundred items
When it increments a variable or appends to an array
When it reads items from a SharePoint list
fragen.erkl: Correct. Variables in parallel loops give unpredictable results. If you use variables, the loop has to run sequentially.
fragen.titel: Run Apply to each in parallel

fragen.frage: How do you keep flow notifications in Teams separated by topic?
antworten: The Flow bot posts to one group chat per topic
All messages are written to a SharePoint list
Everything goes to your personal Flow bot chat
fragen.erkl: You create one group chat per topic and let the Flow bot post there with Post message in a chat or channel. That way not every message lands in the same chat.

fragen.frage: Where do you edit the flow as JSON in the new designer?
antworten: In Code view in the designer
In My clipboard in the action picker
In the run history of the last run
fragen.erkl: Correct. Use Code view in the new designer. In the classic designer, read actions with Peek code or use export.
fragen.titel: Look behind an action with Code View

fragen.frage: What do you need to keep in mind with the free PDF services?
antworten: Most of the connectors are still premium
They only work with Word files as the source
They need no connection in Power Automate
fragen.erkl: Adobe PDF Services, Encodian, Muhimbi and Cloudmersive have free tiers. Their connectors in Power Automate are mostly premium, so you may still need a premium license.

fragen.frage: Which file in the DOCX archive contains the document's text?
antworten: [Content_Types].xml
docProps/app.xml
word/document.xml
fragen.erkl: A DOCX file is a ZIP archive. After extraction, the document's text is in word/document.xml.

fragen.frage: Where is the most efficient place to filter SharePoint data?
antworten: In the Filter Query of Get items, at the source
In a Condition that checks every single item
After retrieving all items, inside a loop
fragen.erkl: The Filter Query in Get items filters with OData directly in SharePoint. The flow then loads only the items it needs instead of fetching everything and sorting it out afterwards.

fragen.frage: Which action fetches web page content without a premium connector?
antworten: Get file content in the SharePoint connector
The HTTP action with a GET request
Upload from URL in the OneDrive connector
fragen.erkl: Upload from URL saves the page as a file in OneDrive, then Get file content reads it as text. Both are standard actions, the HTTP action would be premium.

fragen.frage: How many items does SharePoint Get items return by default, without Pagination and Top Count?
fragen.erkl: Without Pagination and without Top Count, SharePoint returns the first 100 items. 256 is the default of the Excel connector.

fragen.frage: What do Secure Inputs and Secure Outputs do?
antworten: Sensitive data is hidden in the run history
The data is emailed to the owner, encrypted
The action runs faster because less is logged
fragen.erkl: You turn both on in the action's settings. The run history then no longer shows this action's inputs and outputs.

fragen.frage: How does the structured data from ChatGPT get into the flow?
antworten: Via a link with URL-encoded data to the trigger URL
As an email attachment to a mailbox the flow monitors
Through an Excel file that the flow reads regularly
fragen.erkl: ChatGPT URL-encodes the data and appends it to the trigger URL of a flow with an HTTP trigger. One click on the link sends it to Power Automate.

fragen.frage: What are the two ? for in outputs('Compose')?[variables('InputValue')]?['Title']?
antworten: They prevent an error when a key is unknown
They mark the values as optional inputs
They automatically convert the result to text
fragen.erkl: Correct. If the key or the field is missing, the expression returns null instead of an error.

fragen.frage: Which property keeps the guest list of an event hidden in Graph?
antworten: hideAttendees
isReminderOn
isOnlineMeeting
fragen.erkl: With hideAttendees set to true the guest list stays hidden from the attendees. You set it with a PATCH together with the extended attendees list.

fragen.frage: Parse JSON fails with "Expected String but got Null". What helps?
antworten: Adding the field to the required list as well
Setting the type to a list of string and null
Generating the schema from a new sample response
fragen.erkl: Correct. With ["string", "null"] the schema accepts text and null, and validation passes.
fragen.titel: A JSON schema that tolerates null

fragen.frage: How does the app read the environment variable without premium?
antworten: Directly from the Dataverse table with a formula
With a solution flow called in OnStart
Not at all, the app always needs premium
fragen.erkl: A flow inside the solution reads the environment variable and returns it to the app. The app calls it in OnStart and stores the value in a variable.

fragen.frage: What serves as the placeholder in Word for the data from the flow?
antworten: Quick Parts
Comment boxes
Page headers
fragen.erkl: In Word you insert a document property through Quick Parts as a placeholder, which a standard flow fills with data. You do not need premium for this.

fragen.frage: What does the timeout value P14D on an action mean?
antworten: The action only starts after two weeks
The action runs twice a week
The action waits for two weeks at most
fragen.erkl: Correct. P14D is an ISO 8601 duration for 14 days, or two weeks.
fragen.titel: Set a timeout for long-running actions

fragen.frage: What fills the choice list of the Adaptive Card?
antworten: The users of the Power Platform environment
A fixed list of names in a Compose action
"Search for user (V2)" from Office 365 Users
fragen.erkl: "Search for user (V2)" from the Office 365 Users connector returns the people, and a Select action maps them to title and value. These pairs are the choices of the Input.ChoiceSet in the card.

fragen.frage: Which functions do you use in Power Automate to align values before a comparison?
antworten: first() and last()
length() and add()
trim() and toLower()
fragen.erkl: trim() removes spaces at the start and end, toLower() makes everything lowercase. After that, spacing and case no longer break a comparison.

fragen.frage: Which action does the tip use for a simple approval by external people?
antworten: Create item in SharePoint
Start and wait for an approval
Send email with options
fragen.erkl: The standard approval process does not reach external recipients. Send email with options goes to any valid address, and you process the response in the flow.

fragen.frage: According to the tip, how do you call Azure Document Intelligence from a flow?
antworten: With the HTTP action, a premium feature
With the Excel Online standard connector
With a knowledge source in Copilot Studio
fragen.erkl: You take the API key and endpoint from Azure and call the service with the HTTP action. In Power Automate that action is a premium feature.

fragen.frage: According to the tip, how do you get past the 50 parallel iterations of Apply to each?
antworten: With child flows or database triggers
With a higher pagination threshold
With a second trigger in the same flow
fragen.erkl: A child flow per item, or a second flow that fires on new database rows, processes each item independently. The limit of 50 parallel loop iterations then no longer applies.

fragen.frage: What do you do so a copied action works inside a Switch?
antworten: Delete the Switch and create it again from scratch
Paste outside, drag into the branch, reset references
Turn on Concurrency control in the settings
fragen.erkl: The copied action often points to outputs that are not reachable in the branch. You paste it higher up, drag it into the branch and map the dynamic content again.

fragen.frage: What is PowerTools by Paul Murana?
antworten: A built-in Microsoft connector for text tasks
A third-party connector for text processing
A built-in expression function in Power Automate
fragen.erkl: PowerTools is a commercial connector from an independent vendor, not a Microsoft product. It adds actions for cleaning and extracting text to Power Automate.

fragen.frage: Which field contains the file name?
antworten: FileLeafRef
FileDirRef
FileRef
fragen.erkl: FileLeafRef is the file name, FileRef the full path and FileDirRef the folder the file is in.

fragen.frage: Where does the total number of items in a list come from?
antworten: From the list's ItemCount property
From the highest ID found in the list
From the length of Get items, no pagination
fragen.erkl: The REST call to /ItemCount returns the number directly. In a library, folders are counted too.

fragen.frage: Which files does Get file content return without a Base64 detour?
antworten: Image formats like PNG, JPG and GIF
Office files like DOCX and XLSX
Text formats like JSON, CSV and XML
fragen.erkl: Plain-text formats like JSON, CSV, XML or Markdown come back directly as text. You process them without Base64 decoding.

fragen.frage: Which building blocks does the tip use to convert CSV to JSON?
antworten: Create CSV table and Compose
split(), Select and Parse JSON
A premium connector for CSV files
fragen.erkl: split() breaks the CSV into lines and fields, Select maps the values to the column names, and Parse JSON makes the result usable. All of them are standard actions.

fragen.frage: What does the tip replace with a central app and a scheduled flow?
antworten: Each person's Outlook connection
Many individual flows, one per person
The notification through Teams
fragen.erkl: Instead of building a separate flow for each person, one central Power App collects the input, and the flow runs in that person's context. A scheduled flow sends the link to the app.

fragen.frage: What does access via a variable key save you?
antworten: Nested Switch and If structures
The Parse JSON action with its schema
The trigger that starts the flow
fragen.erkl: With body('Parse_JSON')?[variables('key')] you get the value directly by its key. You no longer need a separate branch for each language, role or message type.

fragen.frage: You need the exact casing. Why is the OData filter in SharePoint not enough?
antworten: Because OData only returns 100 items
Because OData ignores upper and lower case
Because Filter array is faster than OData
fragen.erkl: Title eq 'ABC' also returns abc and Abc. Filter array with equals() then compares with the exact casing.

fragen.frage: How do you pass a choice column value in the JSON object for Update item?
antworten: As plain text with the name of the option
As an object with the property Value
As a number with the position of the option
fragen.erkl: Choice columns expect an object with the property Value. Plain text is accepted but clears the column.

fragen.frage: What do you achieve with the app as the starting point?
antworten: Each person runs the flow in their own context
All flows run under the creator's account
Flows no longer need any connections
fragen.erkl: Whoever starts the flow from the app triggers it with the Power Apps (V2) trigger in their own context. A scheduled flow, by contrast, always runs as its owner.

fragen.frage: Why can a Graph request fail with 403 despite an admin role?
antworten: The token lacks the required permission
Chats cannot be read through Graph at all
The Base Resource URL is set incorrectly
fragen.erkl: Correct. Token permissions limit access. An admin role does not extend them.
fragen.titel: Call Microsoft Graph without an app registration

fragen.frage: What does a plus address look like?
antworten: user@tag.domain.com
tag.user@domain.com
user+tag@domain.com
fragen.erkl: The tag follows a plus sign right before the @. The sender address then shows which flow sent the email.

fragen.frage: Which two building blocks read invoices within free tiers and summarize them?
antworten: Power BI and an Excel workbook
Teams chats and a SharePoint list
An OCR connector and Azure AI Language
fragen.erkl: A free-tier OCR connector reads the text from the PDF, Azure AI Language summarizes it. That keeps up to 500 pages per month free.

fragen.frage: Which function turns multiline text into an array?
antworten: split()
join()
concat()
fragen.erkl: split() breaks the text at the line break and returns an array that you loop through with Apply to each.

fragen.frage: According to the tip, which action sets the categories?
antworten: Update event (V4) with the categories field
Send an HTTP request (Office 365 Outlook connector)
The premium HTTP action with its own token
fragen.erkl: The Outlook connector's Send an HTTP request action sends a PATCH to the event and sets the categories. You do not need premium for this.

fragen.frage: Why do you let the AI evaluate only the thumbnail first?
antworten: Because AI services cannot process PDF files
Because thumbnails give more accurate results than PDFs
Because every processed page adds AI costs
fragen.erkl: AI services bill per page or per call, and the key data often sits on the first page. You process the full PDF only when the thumbnail is not enough.

fragen.frage: Why does the first action set TriggerFlow to No right away?
antworten: So the approval is deleted when it expires
So changes during the run don't trigger a new start
So the approver doesn't receive an email
fragen.erkl: Correct. Only the path after the timeout sets TriggerFlow back to Yes. That gives exactly one restart per cycle.

fragen.frage: What does the Trigger Condition Builder on tools.powerplatformtip.com help with?
antworten: It starts flows on a fixed daily schedule
It generates valid trigger conditions from your data
It exports solutions to another environment
fragen.erkl: You paste sample data such as a JSON body and build the condition visually. You copy the finished expression into the trigger conditions of your flow.

fragen.frage: How do you protect an apostrophe in an OData filter?
antworten: You encode it with encodeUriComponent()
You put a backslash in front of it
You double it with replace()
fragen.erkl: Correct. In OData two apostrophes stand for one apostrophe in the value, and the filter stays valid.
fragen.titel: Encode apostrophes and special characters correctly

fragen.frage: What does take(array, 5) return if the array has only three items?
antworten: All three items, without an error
An error, because items are missing
Three items plus two empty ones
fragen.erkl: Correct. take() returns at most the given number. If there are fewer, all existing items come back.
fragen.titel: Shorten loops with take() while testing

fragen.frage: Where does the flow read the decision from with Send email with options?
antworten: From the mailbox's Approvals center
From the dynamic value SelectedOption
From a reply email sent to the flow
fragen.erkl: Correct. Check that SelectedOption is populated. HTML responses can leave fields empty, and UserEmailAddress is not reliable.

fragen.frage: What creates the Markdown in this tip?
antworten: Nested loops
An AI action
Two Office Scripts
fragen.erkl: Two Office Scripts convert JSON and HTML into Markdown, with fixed code, without AI and without premium.

fragen.frage: Why do you rename via FileLeafRef instead of copying?
antworten: Copying is never possible in libraries
FileLeafRef also changes the file extension
ID, versions and metadata are kept
fragen.erkl: Correct. MERGE on FileLeafRef only changes the name. The item itself stays the same.
fragen.titel: Rename a SharePoint file via REST

fragen.frage: Which fields does the MERGE call restore?
antworten: AuthorId, EditorId, Created and Modified
The file's permissions and sharing links
Only the file name and the folder path
fragen.erkl: Copying and deleting loses the creator, last editor and timestamps. A MERGE through Send an HTTP request to SharePoint writes them back.

fragen.frage: What does the expression div(75, 200) return?
antworten: 0, because both values are whole numbers
0.375, because div() always returns decimals
An error, because 75 is smaller than 200
fragen.erkl: Correct. With two whole numbers div() does integer division and cuts off the decimals.
fragen.titel: float() before div() for correct decimals

fragen.frage: Which action calls an Office Script from a flow?
antworten: Run script in the Excel Online (Business) connector
Create file in the OneDrive for Business connector
Update a row inside an Apply to each loop
fragen.erkl: The script is stored in OneDrive, and Run script in the Excel Online (Business) connector runs it on the workbook. You pass parameters in and use return values later in the flow.

fragen.frage: How do nested data get from a flow into a canvas app?
antworten: With a separate output for every field
As JSON text in one output, then ParseJSON
Through the Response action of the HTTP connector
fragen.erkl: Correct. One text output carries any structure, and ParseJSON rebuilds it in the app.
fragen.titel: Return flow data to Power Apps as JSON

fragen.frage: Which call comes before addroleassignment?
antworten: resetroleinheritance
getbyid
breakroleinheritance
fragen.erkl: First breakroleinheritance cuts off the inherited permissions. Then addroleassignment grants exactly the permissions you want.

fragen.frage: Which endpoint do you use to create the columns in the target list?
antworten: fields/addfieldasjson
fields/clonefromschema
fields/createfieldasxml
fragen.erkl: You POST the SchemaXml of each custom column to fields/createfieldasxml on the target list. That creates the columns with the same internal names and settings.

fragen.frage: What must the members array contain for a private channel?
antworten: Only guest accounts from other tenants
At least one person with the owner role
All members of the parent team
fragen.erkl: A private channel needs members when you create it, and at least one of them has roles: ["owner"]. Otherwise Graph rejects the request with a 400.

fragen.frage: Which content type does the ICS file get?
antworten: application/pdf
text/calendar
text/plain
fragen.erkl: The ICS file is plain text in iCalendar format. When you attach it as text/calendar, the mail client offers to add it to the calendar.

fragen.frage: Which Graph endpoint invites guests?
antworten: /v1.0/users
/v1.0/invitations
/v1.0/groups
fragen.erkl: A POST to /v1.0/invitations adds the person as a guest in Microsoft Entra ID. If you want, Graph sends the invitation along with it.

fragen.frage: Why are onPremisesSamAccountName and similar fields missing from a normal query?
antworten: They are stored only in Exchange Online
They need a separate license per user
They only come back if $select names them
fragen.erkl: Without $select, Graph returns only the default fields. If you name the attributes in $select, they are included.

fragen.frage: Which action shows you whether a person is away?
antworten: Office 365 Users: "Get user profile (V2)"
Office 365 Outlook: "Get mail tips for a mailbox (V2)"
Office 365 Outlook: "Get calendar view of events"
fragen.erkl: "Get mail tips for a mailbox (V2)" with the automaticReplies option shows whether automatic replies are on. It works without HTTP and without an app registration.

fragen.frage: Is there a dateDiff() function in cloud flow expressions?
antworten: Yes, but only with a premium license
Yes, it returns the difference in days
No, you calculate the difference with ticks()
fragen.erkl: dateDiff() does not exist. You subtract the ticks() of both timestamps and divide by 864000000000 to get the days as a number.

fragen.frage: What may result() point to in an expression?
antworten: Any action anywhere in the whole flow
Only the trigger at the start of the flow
A Scope, Apply to each or Until
fragen.erkl: Correct. result() reads the actions inside such a container. If it points to a simple action, the flow cannot be saved.
fragen.titel: Read the real error message with result()

fragen.frage: According to the tip, which environment does For a selected item only run from?
antworten: The Default environment
Only Teams environments
Any production environment
fragen.erkl: For a selected item only runs from the Default environment. If the flow lives in a production environment, you start it from a column-formatting button with executeFlow.

fragen.frage: What does the action parameter control in the router flow?
antworten: Whether the flow needs a premium license
The language the agent answers in
The Switch to get, create or update
fragen.erkl: The Switch on action routes to the get, create or update branch. The input parameter carries an OData filter or a JSON body for it.

fragen.frage: What does a run do that finds the IsRunning flag set to Yes?
antworten: It ends without processing anything
It sets the flag to No and starts over
It processes all emails once more
fragen.erkl: If IsRunning is Yes, another run already owns the batch. The run ends with Terminate and the status Succeeded, without touching any emails.

fragen.frage: Why can't an agent correct errors from a directly bound connector itself?
antworten: Agents cannot use connectors in Copilot Studio
Connectors only report errors by email to the owner
Error statuses abort before the model sees the message
fragen.erkl: Any status outside 2xx becomes the hard failure connectorRequestFailure before the language model reads the response. Only a flow that always returns readable JSON makes the error visible to the agent.

fragen.frage: What do you change in the URL to open the hidden export page?
antworten: Append /edit to the end of the address
Append ?export=true to the address
Replace /details with /export
fragen.erkl: On the flow's details page, replace /details at the end of the address with /export. The export page for the .zip package then opens.

fragen.frage: What is the built-in version history not enough for?
antworten: Restoring an earlier saved version
Recovering a flow that was deleted entirely
Viewing older versions of an existing flow
fragen.erkl: The version history only covers flows that still exist. For a deleted flow you need a backup, for example a regular solution export.

fragen.frage: Which setting makes the Teams message come from you instead of the Flow bot?
antworten: Adding more recipients to the chat
Setting Post as to "Flow bot"
Setting Post as to "User"
fragen.erkl: With Post as "User", the action "Post message in a chat or channel" posts in the name of the account behind the Teams connection. With "Flow bot", the message comes from the bot.

fragen.frage: A flow without a trigger condition checks its condition only during the run. What happens on a change that does not match?
antworten: The flow does not start, SharePoint filters first
SharePoint reverts the change to the item
The flow starts anyway and consumes a run
fragen.erkl: Without a trigger condition the flow starts on every change and checks afterwards. A SharePoint Automate Rule or a trigger condition filters first and saves the run.

fragen.frage: Why can you fill a Word template this way without the premium Word connector?
antworten: Because Word fills placeholders itself on opening
Because SharePoint converts Word files into text
Because a .docx file is a ZIP archive of XML
fragen.erkl: A .docx file is a ZIP archive of XML files. You extract it, replace the placeholder in word/document.xml and zip it again.

fragen.frage: Why do you need a separate StateLog list for the progress display?
antworten: Because Power Apps cannot start flows directly
Because Respond to PowerApps can only answer once
Because a timer can only read SharePoint lists
fragen.erkl: Respond to PowerApps answers only once. That is why the flow writes its progress to a StateLog list, which a timer in the app reads regularly.

fragen.frage: Whose permissions does a SharePoint action in the flow use?
antworten: Those of the account behind the stored connection
Always those of the account that triggers the flow
Administrator rights, granted automatically
fragen.erkl: Each action uses the connection that was set up when the flow was built. If it belongs to a service account, the action runs with its permissions, no matter who triggers the flow in the app.

fragen.frage: How do you return an array from a flow to Power Apps?
antworten: As an array output of Respond to a Power App or flow
Not without premium, arrays only work with the Response action
As a JSON text output, parsed in the app with ParseJSON
fragen.erkl: Respond to a Power App or flow only returns flat values. You send the array as JSON text and turn it back into a table in the app with ParseJSON.

fragen.frage: What applies when the same flow sits in several solutions?
antworten: Each solution holds an independent copy
The flow is turned off in all solutions
It stays one flow, changes apply everywhere
fragen.erkl: A flow can sit in several solutions and still remains one single flow. If you change or restore it, that applies in all solutions.

fragen.frage: Which functions do you combine to read cells of an HTML table from an email?
antworten: concat() and join()
json() and first()
xml() and xpath()
fragen.erkl: xml() turns the email's HTML into XML, and xpath() selects rows and cells in it. Ending the path with /text() gives you plain values.
